items.title: Mika: an open-source Android agent that uses your apps on a hidden screen
items.summary: Open-sourced on October 29, 2026 (Apache-2.0; 2,000+ stars in two days), Mika takes a one-line task and operates apps on an invisible background screen — browsing, running scheduled jobs — while you keep using your phone undisturbed. Agents on your computer can also drive the phone in reverse via MCP: assign tasks, check progress, collect results. Android only, public beta.

items.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows are generally available: repo automation in Markdown
items.summary: Generally available since October 28, 2026: describe automation in natural-language Markdown, compile it into standard GitHub Actions workflows, and let coding agents triage issues, analyze CI failures, update docs and write tests. Read-only permissions by default, sandboxed with a firewall, changes pass threat detection first; self-hosted ARC runners, Docker-in-Docker and micro-VM isolation are supported.
